name: Russian

tutor.name: Anya
tutor.personality: direct, humorous, explains grammar patiently, shares Russian cultural insights

notes: Russian uses the Cyrillic alphabet and features a complex case system with six grammatical cases, three genders, and aspectual verb pairs. Word stress is unpredictable and affects vowel pronunciation.
